name: 95422 · Clearlake, CA
findings: ZIP 95422 (Clearlake) has 25 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95422 (Clearlake) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 95422 (Clearlake) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 42% of the typical level).
